text:
sara_support: FYI escalation from Acme — customers started getting SAML login failures right after an IdP cert rotation this morning. They say user logins fail with 'Invalid Destination' and 403s. Repro steps attached by the customer below.

acme_admin: @sara_support here's what we see on our end: after we rotated the signing cert in the IdP metadata, all SSO logins started failing. The SP logs show `SAMLResponse` processing error: Invalid Destination. We tried clearing browser cache and restarting the SP instance, no luck.

acme_admin: repro steps: 1) login via /auth/sso -> redirect to IdP; 2) authenticate; 3) IdP posts SAMLResponse to https://app.acme.example.com/saml/acs (we noticed sometimes IdP sends trailing slash or not) 4) SP returns 403.

sara_support: Can you paste the IdP metadata URL? Also any recent metadata changes?

acme_admin: metadata URL: https://idp.acme.example.com/metadata.xml. We rotated the cert at 06:12 UTC and uploaded new metadata. No other config changes.

jake_infra: grabbing metadata now. running: `curl -sS https://idp.acme.example.com/metadata.xml | xmllint --format -`

jake_infra: quick paste of relevant bits:

```
<md:EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme.example.com">
  <md:IDPSSODescriptor>
    <md:KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <ds:KeyInfo>
        <ds:X509Data>
          <ds:X509Certificate>MIIC...NEW_CERT...AB</ds:X509Certificate>
        </ds:X509Data>
      </ds:KeyInfo>
    </md:KeyDescriptor>
    <md:SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://idp.acme.example.com/sso/post"/>
  </md:IDPSSODescriptor>
  <md:SPSSODescriptor>
    <!-- occasional stray sections -->
  </md:SPSSODescriptor>
</md:EntityDescriptor>
```

jake_infra: Also noticed two KeyDescriptor elements — one for signing and one for encryption. Order is signing first (new cert).

kyle_idp: @jake_infra can you check the metadata signature? we had a bug where metadata re-signed with the new cert but the metadata signature referencing the old key remained (ordering race).

jake_infra: running signature check with our parser. output:

```
metadata-validate --url https://idp.acme.example.com/metadata.xml
INFO: fetched metadata
WARN: found KeyDescriptor order change
ERROR: signature verification failed: certificate thumbprint mismatch (expected AA:BB:CC..., found 33:44:55...)
```

jake_infra: so signature validation failed. But the IdP also posted SAMLResponses that validate against the new cert sometimes. The SP logs show:

```
2026-03-15T06:18:22Z SP: Received SAMLResponse for ACS https://app.acme.example.com/saml/acs
2026-03-15T06:18:22Z SP: Destination mismatch: expected https://app.acme.example.com/saml/acs/ (with trailing slash)
2026-03-15T06:18:22Z SP: Rejecting assertion, Invalid Destination
```

acme_admin: we saw that too. IdP occasionally sends ACS with or without trailing slash depending on login flow.

sara_support: two likely issues colliding: 1) metadata signature/thumbprint mismatch due to rotation and order changes; 2) ACS URL canonicalization (trailing slash) mismatch causing Invalid Destination. Need to address both.

kyle_idp: For 1) we think the IdP reissued metadata but the signing process included both old and new certs and re-ordered KeyDescriptor; our parser currently binds the signature verification to the first KeyDescriptor entry which can be brittle. Short term we can: a) accept any KeyDescriptor certificate that validates signature; b) force metadata refresh and fall back to a cached previous metadata that validated.

jake_infra: For 2) we can be more flexible in destination matching — normalize by stripping trailing slash for comparison and accept either variant. But need to ensure it's safe (redirects and anti-replay). We'll open a canary change on the SP to relax exact-match for trailing slash only.

sara_support: Acme wants immediate fix. Recommended mitigation: 1) Ask Acme IdP team to re-publish metadata with a single canonical ACS URL (no ambiguous trailing slash) and re-sign. 2) We will push a hotfix to metadata verifier to try all KeyDescriptor entries for signature validation and to ignore ordering. 3) Temporary workaround: we can re-seed their IdP cert into our trust store manually so the new cert is trusted right away — do you want us to do that, @acme_admin?

acme_admin: Yes please, manual seed would be fastest. Also we'll fix ACS URL on our side to be consistent.

jake_infra: I updated the trust store for the Acme tenant with the new cert thumbprint 33:44:55:66:77 (applied at 06:42 UTC). Also cleared metadata cache for that tenant.

idp-bot: metadata-refresh event: tenant=acme_admin status=success refreshed_at=2026-03-15T06:42:10Z changed_certs=[33:44:55:66:77]

jake_infra: After clearing cache and seeding cert, I triggered a test auth and got a successful assertion flow:

```
2026-03-15T06:43:01Z SP: Received SAMLResponse for ACS https://app.acme.example.com/saml/acs
2026-03-15T06:43:01Z SP: Signature validated using cert thumbprint 33:44:55:66:77
2026-03-15T06:43:01Z SP: Destination check passed (normalized)
2026-03-15T06:43:01Z SP: Assertion accepted, session created
```

acme_admin: confirmed logins working for our first 20 users after seeding. We'll push a metadata cleanup (single cert, consistent ACS) and re-roll on our side in the next 30 minutes. Thanks for the quick help. :tada:

sara_support: Follow-ups: 1) infra to land parser fix to try all KeyDescriptor entries and add telemetry for metadata-order changes. 2) runtime change to normalize ACS trailing slash acceptance (canary first). 3) Ops to add a runbook entry for manual trust-store seed and cache-clear steps. Assigning tasks: @jake_infra will do 1+2 canary; @kyle_idp will coordinate with Acme for metadata reorder.

jake_infra: I'll open PR for parser fix and a canary deploy to staging. PR link: https://git.redwood/infer/metadata-fix/pull/412 (will notify when canary passes).

kyle_idp: I'll reach out to Acme IdP team to ask them to re-publish canonical metadata and confirm signing step.

acme_admin: we'll also add a post-rotation checklist to avoid this next time (ensure metadata signed with final cert and single canonical ACS).

sara_support: closing the elevated incident once PR merges and Acme confirms cleanup. Thanks everyone.

jake_infra: note for postmortem: edgecase where metadata reorder + cert rotation + ACS trailing-slash variance = outage. We'll quantify how many tenants could be affected and add alerts for metadata-validate failures.

sara_support: Filing follow-up ticket and PM loop.

acme_admin: thanks again — will ping here after we've re-published.
